confirmed_facts.fact: Order ORD-2009 is an electric kettle (category Home), AED 189.00, delivered 2026-11-01 12:00 +04:00.
Return RET-2009 was requested 2026-11-02 10:10 +04:00 with reason 'Damaged on arrival', about 0.9 days after delivery, inside the 14-day window under Return v2.
The return pickup was attempted on 2026-11-03 and the parcel has not been collected; no warehouse receipt or inspection exists yet.
The customer's only statement is 'it came broken'; support asked what is damaged and no reply is recorded. No photos or scans exist for this case.

findings.description: The damage claim has no description of the damage beyond 'it came broken' and no customer photo. Return v2 2.3 requires a short description and at least one photo; the claim stays open until provided. A draft request to the customer has been saved.

evidence.quote: Could you tell us what is damaged?

findings.description: No warehouse receipt or inspection record exists because the parcel has not been collected, so the damage cannot be confirmed yet.

policy_references.quote: Claims that an item arrived damaged need a short description of the damage and at least one photo, sent within 48 hours of delivery. Without them, the claim stays open until they are provided.
Home and other non-electronic items: **14 days** from delivery.
Missing evidence is requested from the party that holds it (seller, courier, warehouse or customer). Never assume what it would show.

findings.rationale: The return is inside the applicable window, but the damage claim lacks the description and photo that Return v2 2.3 requires, and the parcel has not been collected so there is no warehouse inspection. A draft request to the customer for the description, a photo and a rebooked pickup is saved for approval. Refund review should wait until the evidence and inspection are available.
findings.uncertainty_note: Unknown whether the item is damaged, and whether the customer will supply a photo. The kettle is recorded as category Home; if it is treated as electronics the 7-day window would still be met, but this was not checked by the tools.
